judges_raw: (Before Dr Anita Sumanth and Sunder Mohan, JJ.)
respondents: Deputy Inspector General of Prisons and Another
advocates: Additional Public Prosecutor assisted by Mr. M. Sylvester John
prayer: Prayer: Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying to issue a writ of mandamus directing the respondents to grant 28 days ordinary leave for petitioner's son, namely, Aarunth, S/o. Sirajudeen (aged about 33 years) Convict Prisoner, PID 69955, Central Prison, Chennai
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Dr Anita Sumanth, J.:— The prayer of the petitioner for a mandamus directing the respondents to grant 28 days ordinary leave without escort for petitioner's son Aarunth, S/o. Sirajudeen, Convict Prisoner, PID 69955, Central Prison, Chennai, does not survive in light of order dated 31-12-2025, under which, in fact, the convict's subsequent representation has been accepted.

2. Recording the aforesaid, we close this writ petition as no further orders are required to be passed in this petition. No costs.
